summary: MDJM LTD filed a Form 6-K disclosing entry into a Share Purchase Agreement by its wholly-owned subsidiary Mansions Catering and Hotel LTD to acquire 45 shares (75% controlling stake) of Japan-based Mirai Co., Ltd. from seller Leyong Lin. No financial terms (price per share, premium, or implied value) were disclosed in the filing. The acquisition represents a strategic expansion into international animation IP and cultural project initiatives. No board recommendation, advisor, or specific closing timeline was mentioned. The deal is subject to customary closing conditions. Investors should watch for further disclosure of financial terms and regulatory filings. The risk-arb angle is limited given the lack of pricing details.
